Windows can also be decorated with grilles, valances, and other decorative elements to enhance their appearance and provide additional functionality, such as privacy or shading.
Overall, windows play a crucial role in the design and function of many buildings and vehicles, and they continue to evolve and improve with advancements in materials science, technology, and design.
